Sonnet claimed to be the doctor on day three, only once the vote had tied, and that claim held through a tie and a runoff. On day one the town voted out Sol, a killer, but on day two Sonnet, Haiku, and Gemma all piled onto Terra, who was the officer, and the town lost its investigator. Luna dodged nearly every question across three days, and Haiku kept pressing her while Sonnet and Gemma pushed back on Haiku. On day four the town finally voted out Luna, the second killer, and the town won, though Haiku regrets pushing Sonnet, who was the real doctor.
